capabilities: Switch between spaces via a sidebar of icons
Auto-save and restore layouts when switching spaces
Assign per-space themes and light/dark/system mode
Reorder spaces with drag and drop
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Syncing across devices requires syncing specific config files (.obsidian/workspaces.json and plugin data.json) and excluding workspace.json; mobile is read-only for layouts.
intentEvidence: extends Obsidian's built-in Workspace functionality to provide a fast and intuitive context switching experience
problem: Obsidian's built-in Workspaces only save and load layouts manually, so switching between contexts for different tasks is slow and disruptive.

relations.evidence: extends Obsidian's built-in Workspace functionality to provide a fast and intuitive context switching experience

summary: Workspace-switching toolkit that adds a sidebar of spaces with auto-save/restore layouts and per-space themes on top of Obsidian Workspaces.
